outcome: Platelet count throughout pregnancy and at delivery
cohort: 75 pregnant women with ITP in Sweden
finding: A routine of avoiding treatment for ITP when platelet counts are at least 20 x 10^9/L during pregnancy and aiming for 100 x 10^9/L at delivery appears safe, and severe maternal thrombocytopenia and prior neonatal thrombocytopenia were predictors of neonatal thrombocytopenia.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery and blood loss were similar to a reference group.
